name: 16432-multiimagevqa-7bvlm-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one vLLM V1 engine, everything else at the engine's own defaults.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration: 28 layers, 28 query / 4 KV heads, hidden 3584, bf16, AWQ 4-bit language weights with the vision tower left unquantized.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=4, the first 20% of completions are warmup, bounded at 200 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: One request carries eight distinct 728x1036 jpeg pages (quality 85, gradient content, seeds 42..49) and a 16-token question, answered in exactly 10 tokens, single turn, greedy. Declared as eight separate guidellm `synthetic_image` datasets rather than one with images_per_request=8, because guidellm 0.7.3 reads a suffixed image column as a conversation TURN and the single-entry form silently yields an eight-turn chat carrying one image each; `limit-mm-per-prompt` must keep matching the count.
purpose: A document question-answering assistant reading eight scanned pages per question with ten-token answers, four concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# One vLLM engine on one H100 serving a document-VQA workload that sends eight distinct
# scanned-page images per request and asks one short question about them.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-AWQ

tensor-parallel-size: 1

dtype: bfloat16

# FORCED BY THE WORKLOAD: the engine admits one image per prompt by default, and this must equal
# the number of `synthetic_image` entries in scenario.json exactly -- change one, change both.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 8}

# The pixel budget, min_pixels = 28*28 and max_pixels = 1000*28*28, capping each image at ~1000
# vision tokens. A 728x1036 page is 754,208 px, under the cap, so it is not downscaled.
mm-processor-kwargs: {"min_pixels": 784, "max_pixels": 784000}

max-model-len: 102400

# A real ceiling: above the declared load of 4 streams, so it does not bind at the operating
# point, but it caps any walk of the stream count at 8 concurrent requests.
max-num-seqs: 8

max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
